# Reich & Binstock LLP

> > Houston-based personal injury law firm specializing in sexual abuse claims, social media addiction lawsuits, and product liability litigation nationwide.

Reich & Binstock LLP is a national personal injury law firm headquartered in Houston, Texas, with deep expertise in civil sexual abuse claims under the Child Victims Act, social media platform liability for youth mental health harm, and video game addiction litigation. The firm handles complex class actions and multi-district litigations (MDLs) against major tech platforms and institutions.
